inspect gas valve and check manifold gas pressure
inspect ignition system and safety controls
inspect control box, associated controls, wiring and connections
check combustion blower housing for lint and debris
inspect evaporator coil, drain pan and condensate drain lines

symptoms.symptom: furnace makes loud noise when main burners ignite

causes.cause: buildup on main burners causing faulty firing
blocked vent causing draft safeguard switch to shut off
high-temperature condition due to inadequate combustion air

procedures.title: Clean or replace air filter
procedures.safety_note: Failure to follow this caution may result in product damage. Never operate your furnace without a filter in place.
steps: Turn off electrical supply to the furnace
Slide air filter out of filter cabinet
Inspect the filter. If torn, replace it
Wash filter (if dirty) in sink, bathtub, or outside with a garden hose
Turn on electrical supply to furnace
Turn on electrical supply to furnace

procedures.title: Inspect combustion area and vent system
procedures.task: inspect combustion area and vent system
procedures.safety_note: Failure to follow this warning could result in personal injury or death. If dirt, rust, soot, or scale accumulations are found, call your dealer. Do not operate your furnace.
steps: Turn off electrical supply to the furnace and remove the access door
Carefully inspect the gas burner for dirt, rust, or scale
Inspect the elbow, flue connection area, and the vent pipe for rust
Inspect the vent pipe for a sag, holes, or a disconnection
Restore electrical power to the furnace
Start the furnace and observe its operation
